answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) aims to teach machines to ask human-like questions from a range of inputs such as natural language texts, images and knowledge bases.
datasets: CoQA (modified dataset containing 7.2K passages and 81.9K questions)

answer_2.quote: Following the conventions, we used BLEU, ROUGE-L and METEOR as automatic evaluation metrics. We also computed the average word-number of generated questions.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation in five aspects. ... We randomly selected 20 passages from the test set with 207 given answers and asked 10 native speakers to evaluate the outputs of each model independently.
answer_4.guideline: Reviewers are asked to choose a score from {1, 2, 3} for each aspect.
